prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, strong silhouette at 200 pixels, tactile painterly textures, cinematic low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, magical energy ribbons or floating runes; source fidelity and respect for living traditions.
ANATOMY: PACHAMAMA in documented woman-bearing-COCA-LEAVES representation. ONE mature human woman's head with broad strong cheekbones and lined maternal face, TWO eyes, TWO normal human arms/hands, fully opaque dark woven shawl and long crimson-gold skirt; no horns, crown, wings, weapons or extra limbs. Hold a substantial bundle of recognizable small smooth oval COCA LEAVES prominently before her torso, one arm supports leaves while the other extends toward newly living earth. [pachamama-c08] MOMENT: Lean and sweep toward viewer from beside a sacred tree, lower open hand toward soil while the other holds leaves close, strong diagonal posture and intense compassionate gaze; no still frontal pose. POWER: earth beneath her forward hand flourishes into living root arches and unfolding green leaves, natural tangible plants, no light emitted by hand/body, no energy ribbons. This physically visualizes her earth-fertilizing cosmic motherhood c14 and life-sustaining creative power c04. SCALE & CAMERA: very tight low-view three-quarter sacred portrait, head, leaf-bearing torso, forward hand fill 90 percent; tiny tree shrine and terraces far below at lower edge provide editorial devotional hierarchy for cosmic mother, not factual giant anatomy. Distinct from full-body potatoes composition. LIGHT & WEATHER: one late sun side-shaft through sacred tree, strong gold rim on coca leaves and garment, dark walnut shadow, moving leaf fragments and soil dust ordinary not magic. SURFACE: heavy opaque woven cloth, textured maternal face, real matte coca leaves with visible veins, exposed roots and old bark. SETTING: legendary tree trunk and sacred rocks of earthly shrines, Andes implied in tiny background only. [pachamama-c01/c08] MOOD: awe-inspiring life-giving sacred mother in active creation, no sexualization, no ordinary garden woman.

visual_requirements.description: Source woman bearing a harvest of potatoes in A or coca leaves in B; one human head, two arms/hands, fully opaque editorial Andean clothing.
Earth visibly flourishes with living shoots, roots and plants, interpreting cosmic fertility/life sustenance; no generic magical emission.
Andean earthly sacred landscape with rocks/tree shrine motifs; monumentality uses editorial cosmic-mother hierarchy rather than documented giant anatomy.

selection_reason: Retained coca-leaf sacred-tree close alternative: active creative hand and tiny shrine strong, but potato harvest A more immediately recognizable.

visual_review.notes: Native viewed: mature Andean woman with opaque shawl/skirt holds a large bundle of matte oval coca leaves in one hand while the other reaches into flourishing roots/leaves near low camera. One head/two eyes/two arms and hands, sacred old tree behind, minute shrine assembly below. Strong low view and growing earth convey sacred mother rather than ordinary garden woman; no weapons, text, nakedness or emitted energy.
limitations: Exact leaf depiction, age, braids, dress, shrine/assembly and old-tree species are editorial.
Apparent monumental sacred scale is interpretive, not literal documented giant size.
Lower limbs outside portrait/under opaque skirt.
